content:
Tom Adler: Quick sync note — vendors asked for a consolidated dry-run for H100/H200, MI300, and Gaudi next Thu. Need marketplace image digests + SI test window by Wed EOD.
Priya Nair: confirmed. Which marketplaces? AWS/GCP/Azure?
Tom Adler: all three if possible. If not, we publish AWS first and stagger others by 30m.
Omar Ruiz: Gaudi still waiting on kernel backport (PR #487). If that misses Wed night, we hold gaudi from the initial publish.
Lina Wu: marketing wants embargo contacts and final hero images by Wed 11am PT. Also need alternate headlines in case MI300 drops.
Tom Adler: agreed on alternates. Priya/Omar — can you push partners for image by Tue 6pm PT?
Priya Nair: pinged NVIDIA and AMD PMs. Habana (Gaudi) needs another code review cycle; told them Tue EOD.
Omar Ruiz: CI note 
```
# smoke run
./smoke.sh --suite=quick --timeout=25m --record
journalctl -u inference -o short-iso > /tmp/rt-kern.log
```
Lina Wu: comms fallback: full announce minus Gaudi/MI300 if they slip. Publish plan must include a staggered marketplace cadence doc.
Tom Adler: risk list: 1) gaudi kernel (high) 2) MI300 QAT flakiness (med) 3) Azure publish delay (low). Prioritize 1 & 2.
QA-bot: Test matrix status: h100: pass, h200: pass, mi300: flaky (2 failures last night), gaudi: pending kernel.
Priya Nair: partners requested a +2h verification window for MI300 before public release. Acceptable?
Tom Adler: yes, we can build that into the runbook. Also need Eng-Infra to simulate marketplace publish and rollback Tue 9am PT.
Omar Ruiz: infra can stage to test buckets and generate digests; need partner test creds for full end-to-end.
partner-bot: Dry-run scheduled: 2025-04-10 10:00PT. Reminder set for 2025-04-10 09:15PT internal brief.
Lina Wu: I'll prepare two headline variants and circulate by Wed 9am.
Tom Adler: final asks: partners confirm image availability, SI smoke window, and embargo officer contact by Wed EOD. I'll assemble runbook on Thu 8am.
Priya Nair: sending template to vendors now.
Omar Ruiz: adding gaudi PR owner to the thread via DM.
QA-bot: Noting: include perf sanity check (50-token latency) for H100 and Gaudi images as part of smoke.
Tom Adler: thanks — updating runbook checklist: embargo contacts, image digests, marketplace tags, SI pass/fail, perf snapshot, marketing assets.
partner-bot: Thread snapshot saved. Reply in-thread for urgent updates. :white_check_mark:
